name: kamal-ansible-manager
description: Ansible setup for Docker and Ubuntu server hardening before deploying with Kamal.
details: Installs and configures Docker, Fail2ban, UFW, time sync, security updates, SSH policy and swap.
best_for: You want consistent Ubuntu baseline provisioning.
caveat: Review SSH/firewall changes carefully to avoid losing remote access.

name: terraform-hetzner
description: Terraform example separating Kamal web hosts from private accessory hosts at Hetzner.
details: Creates web and data servers, SSH jump-host configuration, and optional load balancing with more web machines.
best_for: You want a concrete multi-server Kamal provisioning example.
caveat: Adapt its infrastructure assumptions and firewall rules before using it in production.

name: kitsune-kit
description: Pre-1.0 CLI for provisioning DigitalOcean Ubuntu hosts for Docker and Kamal.
details: Uses init/doctor/plan/apply steps to configure a tagged Droplet, SSH, UFW, Docker, and optional data services.
best_for: You want a guided DigitalOcean server setup with a reviewed change plan.
caveat: Supported systems are intentionally limited; the state format may change before 1.0.

name: dsd-vps-kamal
description: Django Simple Deploy plugin generating Kamal configuration for an existing VPS.
details: Generates deploy.yml, Dockerfile, secrets, and Django production settings, with optional full deployment automation.
best_for: You use Django and want help preparing a Kamal deployment.
caveat: Pre-1.0; provisioning and securing the VPS is out of scope.

name: shipyard
description: Opinionated Ansible, Tailscale, Cloudflare, and Caddy setup for Kamal hosting.
details: Builds private networking, server roles, TLS, Postgres/Redis, backups and optional telemetry before handing application deploys to Kamal.
best_for: You want a repeatable self-hosted stack rather than a series of manual VPS setup steps.
caveat: It makes substantial infrastructure choices; understand the Cloudflare and Tailscale dependencies.

name: Single Server
description: Single-server app delivery system incorporating Kamal, Docker, GitHub, and Cloudflare.
details: A more opinionated self-hosting interface built around pushing code to one Linux server.
best_for: You want to compare managed-feeling single-host delivery to running Kamal directly.
caveat: Its workflows are not identical to vanilla Kamal; evaluate the architecture first.
